input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An ad delivery system is designed to match users with relevant ads based on their interests and behaviors. The system aims to optimize ad exposure, ensuring that the right users see the right ads at the right time. It also seeks to provide a fair and unbiased ad experience for all users, regardless of their background or characteristics.
